Gina P: Quick heads-up — we have 6 new hires starting next Tue with staggered times (onsite + hybrid). Kiosk reservations are clashing and one candidate needs a notarized I-9. Can we triage slots, buddy assignments, and BGC intake? cc @it-support @facilities :wave:

Marc S: Yup. Can you paste the list and preferred start windows? I can try to free up a kiosk slot.

Gina P: ```
1) Arun Patel — 09:30 onsite — needs badge + laptop
2) Mei Chen — 10:15 hybrid — remote I-9 ok? passport expiring
3) Luis Gomez — 13:00 onsite — BGC pending SSN verification
4) Priya Rao — 14:30 onsite — needs notary (SF)
5) Samir Khatri — 15:00 remote — BGC cleared
6) Zoe Park — 16:00 hybrid — new hire paperwork incomplete
```

Marc S: Ok, I freed up the 14:00 slot by moving an internal training. Reserved 14:00 kiosk for cohort overlap. @Katie L can you confirm buddy coverage for 09:30? :thumbsup:

Tasha O: I can cover 09:30 buddy if someone confirms laptop pickup. @it-support-bot any ETA on devices?

it-support-bot: Device staging confirmed for cohort A. Ticket #INC-2912. Laptops available for pickup at 08:45.

Emma B: I've kicked off BGC intake for Arun, Mei, Luis, and Zoe. Luis and Zoe missing SSN verification — I emailed them and set a 48h follow-up.

Joe F: Facilities can do badge pickup + elevator escort. Need final names by EOD to print badges. Also, Priya requiring notary in SF — we can route her to our vendor but need booking details.

Katie L: For notary: contact `contactless-notary@redwood.com` (SF partner). We can book a 30m window and courier the badge afterwards. Priya — ping me her availability and I’ll schedule.

Marc S: Quick ops note — use this command to reserve additional kiosk slots if needed: `/reserve-kiosk --floor 3 --slot 14:00 --duration 30m` (ops tool).

Gina P: Awesome. Action items: Marc adjust day1 calendar + invites; Tasha buddy at 09:30; Emma chase SSN verifications; Joe finalize badge print by EOD; Katie book notary for Priya. If anything blocks, flag here. Reconvene 4pm if unresolved. :ok_hand:
